docs.title: Discord Bot Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the internal technical documentation for the Discord Bot project. This system is designed as a modular Discord automation helper featuring structural Cogs, localized API wrappers, and background web keep-alive capabilities.

docs.title: 🚀 Fast Track Setup
docs.text:
Ensure you have your Python virtual environment activated:

source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py

docs.title: Key Functional Areas
docs.text:
• Features: Modular discord extensions (Greetings, General management, LeetCode fetching tracking).
  • Keep-Alive Server: Native containerized web micro-layer to maintain active status across persistent hosting platforms.
  • Testing: Modular pytest suite validating background domain actions and event responses.

docs.title: LeetCode Feature Engineering
docs.text: Tracks developer metrics and processes problem-solving queries straight through user Discord chats.

docs.title: Sub-component Interactions
docs.text:
1. Trigger: User requests information in a command routed to src/bot/cogs/leetcode_cog.py.
  2. Business Rule Engine: Data passes through rules defined inside src/core/domains/leetcode/.
  3. External Fetching: Downstream network execution triggers queries via the src/web/external_apis/leetcode_wrapper_apis.py handler.

docs.title: Architectural Overview
docs.text: The backend uses a Clean Architecture boundary, separating operational Discord interfaces from underlying business domains and web clients.

docs.title: Directory Map
docs.text:
• src/bot/: Entrypoint for discord client initialization and Cogs registration.
  • src/core/: Pure business layer tracking isolated application constraints (Greetings logic, LeetCode criteria definitions).
  • src/web/: External connection logic interacting with the LeetCode wrapper API layer.
  • src/utils/: Shared systems including structured platform stream logging configurations.

docs.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
docs.text: The application runs seamlessly across virtual infrastructure environments through native Docker abstraction.

docs.title: Local Container Bootstrapping
docs.text:
Build and launch the background tasks alongside web keep-alive endpoints:

docker compose up --build -d

docs.title: Configuration Mapping
docs.text:
• Dockerfile: Minimal footprint Python container runtime layer.
  • compose.yaml: Multi-tiered environment variable and volume definitions preserving state and app.log persistence safely across host processes.

docs.title: Testing and Coverage Execution
docs.text: Testing frameworks target modular behavioral patterns to avoid dependency errors.

docs.title: HTML Code Coverage Reports
docs.text: The environment produces automated coverage maps utilizing project css parameters: * report.html: Comprehensive breakdown tracking test coverage metrics. * report_style.css: Styling layer providing readability across generated pipelines.
